correctness.rationale: A six-dimensional free two-step Lie automorphism is uniquely a pair (g,f), with g in GL3 and f an arbitrary nine-dimensional central shear. The natural three-dimensional exterior-square action equals det(g) times inverse transpose under the exterior pairing. Fixed vectors therefore reduce to rank-t maps from the 1-eigenspace (dimension a) to the cokernel of the exterior-square minus identity (dimension c), each rank-t map having q^(9-ac) lifts. The determinant fibers of GL3 have exact first/second Gaussian fixed-subspace moments. Their only overlapping nonidentity eigenvalues correspond to the semisimple 1+1+lambda and Jordan2(1)+lambda conjugacy types, whose centralizer orders yield the two intersection counts. These arguments reconstruct the full P(a,c) table, all rank coefficients, odd-characteristic scalar exception, and normalization. Replayed exhaustive GL3(2), GL3(3), GL3(4) tests and all 86016 binary automorphisms agree; finite tests alone are not the proof. No field restriction or division by 2 enters.

value.rationale: The natural automorphism action on the six-dimensional universal class-two rank-three Lie algebra has seven possible fixed-space dimensions, and the theorem computes the multiplicity of every one uniformly for every prime power. This is a complete arithmetic distribution of a canonical invariant, not an arbitrary sample of small matrices. The characteristic parity correction in the fixed-point-free coefficient is explained by scalar -I on the three generators. A Burnside identity detects the exact three natural element orbits and independently cross-checks the census. The value is in the explicit joint GL3 eigenspace enumeration and all shear fibers, not in the already-known semidirect-product description alone.
